jobs.prompt:
Delta review round 2 of release train 5. The round-1 blocker (money in the Command Center API/UI) was fixed; the round-1 delta then failed with ONE blocker: the Cockpit Classic tab linked to '/classic' with no page token, so the watch server answered 403. The fix is in coordination/review/train5-delta2.diff (against the delta head 0bdce95d); the changed source and tests are in context.

What changed: cc-cockpit-mount.js now appends the current location.search to BOTH the Command Center and Classic tab hrefs (keeping aria-current), and tests/command-center-routes-flag.test.mjs renders the Cockpit with a fake location.search '?t=abc' and asserts '/classic?t=abc' and '/command-center?t=abc' instead of the old source regex.

Pass bar: confirm the token blocker is CLOSED (the rendered Classic anchor preserves the query/token, and the test would fail on the tokenless form) and there is no NEW blocker: the Cockpit mount still works without a defaultView/location (SSR/tests), the Hive tab behavior is unchanged, no money/login regression, no test weakened. Everything else is a follow-up. The runner stamps the reviewed head into your result; do NOT add or change a head field. Write ONLY coordination/review/train5-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail only if blockers is non-empty.
